titulo: What If the Moon Disappeared? 5 Myths vs Reality
premisa: Mito contra realidad, en segunda persona. 'You look up tonight... and the Moon is gone.' Se desmontan 5 mitos en escalada, de lo inmediato a lo planetario: MYTH 1 'Earth flies out of orbit' → REALITY: nothing happens to our orbit, the Sun holds us; you'd just notice nights get way darker. MYTH 2 'The tides stop' → REALITY: the Sun still pulls the oceans, but tides shrink to roughly a third of their usual range; tidal pools and coastal food chains get hit hard. MYTH 3 'Animals won't care' → REALITY: corals on the Great Barrier Reef time their mass spawning by moonlight, dung beetles navigate by it, baby sea turtles use bright horizons to find the sea; their clocks break. MYTH 4 'Our seasons stay the same' → REALITY: the Moon keeps Earth's tilt steady around 23.5°; without it, over millions of years the tilt could drift far more, bringing brutal seasonal swings. Bonus: no more solar eclipses, ever. MYTH 5 'This could never happen' → giro.
gancho: What if the Moon vanished tonight? Would Earth go flying out of orbit? Nope. The real problems are weirder.
